company_name: IRSA Inversiones Y Representaciones S.A. Global
title: “Ramblas del Plata” Commercialization Progress – August 31, 2026
summary: La entrada “Ramblas del Plata” Commercialization Progress – August 31, 2026 se publicó primero en IRSA .
body_markdown:
##### The company has signed a barter agreement for a new lot of 2,095 m² with an estimated total saleable area of 7,483 sqm, belonging to the extended first stage of the “Ramblas del Plata” project.


The transaction amounts to USD 6.7 million, which will be paid to IRSA through an upfront cash payment and saleable sqm to be received in the future.


The Company will continue infrastructure work on the “Ramblas del Plata” plot while advancing with the signing of agreements for the commercialization of the project.
